# Matching dependency sources

Download **SystemCompanion-ThirdPartySource.zip** from the [matching release](https://github.com/himwithnoname-boop/System-Companion/releases).

It contains unmodified GPL flashing-tool/stub sources and MPL sensor-library sources, plus the Python tool dependencies. [sources.json](sources.json) pins every archive URL, version/commit, size and SHA-256 hash. Upstream build instructions are retained in each archive.

The source index is regenerated by `python tools/prepare-release-sources.py` during release preparation. Source downloads happen only during development/packaging, not when running the installer or clients. See [notices](../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
